target.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves When OpenClaw sends messages to Feishu via `msg_type: post` with `tag: md`, single newline characters (`\n`) are rendered as plain spaces by the Feishu IM API. This causes multi-paragraph prose to appear visually cramped — lines that should appear on separate rows are joined together with only a space, making long messages very difficult to read. The root cause is that `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` in `send.ts` passes `messageText` verbatim into the Feishu post+md payload. Feishu's post+md renderer collapses a single `\n` to a space; only `\n\n` is treated as a paragraph break. Fixes #97074 ## Why This Change Was Made Added `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines()` — a dedicated function that upgrades single `\n` to `\n\n` outside code regions for Feishu post+md rendering. It is applied at three entry points: 1. `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` in `send.ts` — the core post+md payload builder 2. `feishuOutbound.chunker` in `outbound.ts` — outbound text chunking path 3. `reply-dispatcher.ts` — reply message path (non-card mode) Card-based messages are explicitly excluded because they use a different rendering engine that handles single newlines correctly. The function is idempotent (applying it twice produces the same result), skips fenced and inline code regions so code examples preserve their original line shape, and uses `findCodeRegions` from the existing text-chunking SDK. This approach was chosen over alternatives like `
` injection or modifying the Feishu SDK because: - It is a minimal, bounded fix within the Feishu plugin boundary - `
` tags are not standard markdown and could have unexpected side effects - Using `findCodeRegions` reuses existing battle-tested SDK logic ## User Impact All agents using the Feishu channel are affected. Long messages with multiple paragraphs, lists, or structured content become nearly unreadable (`文字挤在一起` — text crammed together). After this fix, single-newline-separated paragraphs render as proper paragraph breaks in the Feishu client. ## Evidence - `pnpm test extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` — 156 passed - Autoreview: clean (all findings addressed) Behavior addressed: Feishu post+md rendering collapses single `\n` to space; upgrade to `\n\n` for paragraph breaks outside code regions Real environment tested: N/A (unit tests cover all entry points and edge cases including code block preservation, inline code spans, idempotency, and existing double-newline preservation) Exact steps or command run after this patch: `pnpm test extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` Evidence after fix: 156 tests passed across 3 test files (27 send, 43 outbound, 86 reply-dispatcher) Observed result after fix: `\n` between non-empty prose lines is upgraded to `\n\n`, producing proper paragraph breaks in Feishu; code regions and inline code are untouched; function is idempotent What was not tested: Live Feishu API roundtrip (the normalization is a pure text transformation covered by unit tests at all three entry points); card paths are intentionally excluded
